subject: Logic
title: Poincaré Conjecture
description: A fast breakdown of Poincaré Conjecture for builders.

hook.text: A million-dollar prize, a century of failure, and the recluse who solved it and turned down the money.

buildup.text: The Poincaré conjecture asked: is every simply connected 3D shape essentially a sphere? Proposed in 1904.

discovery.text: In 2003, Grigori Perelman posted his proof online—no journal, no fanfare. Just dense, brilliant mathematics.

twist.text: Perelman declined the Fields Medal and the million-dollar Clay prize. He said understanding was reward enough.

climax.text: His proof used Ricci flow—essentially melting shapes and showing they smooth into spheres.

punchline.text: Solved the unsolvable. Declined the reward.
